scanNote:
GRAMMAR REFERENCE, 11-BET (126-bet). Yuqorida chapda 'Grammar Reference'.

CHAP USTUN (Some/Any/No davomi):
KO'K JADVAL 'Negative': Determiners: no/not any | Pronouns - people: no one/not anyone/nobody/not anybody, things: nothing/not anything | Adverbs - places: nowhere/not anywhere.
• Some is used before plural nouns and countable/uncountable nouns. 'I need some oranges. She wanted some information.' Some and its compounds (someone, something, etc) are normally used in affirmative sentences. They can also be used in questions to make an offer, a request or when we expect a positive answer. 'There's someone on the phone for you. Would you like something to drink? (offer) Can I have something to read? (request) Is there someone in the living room? (I expect there is.) but: Is there anyone in the living room? (I'm asking in general.)'
• Any is used before plural countable nouns and uncountable nouns. 'Are there any apples in the fridge? Is there any milk left?' Any and its compounds (anyone, anything, etc) are normally used in questions. 'Is there anyone at home?' They can also be used in positive sentences meaning "It doesn't matter how/what/when/where/which/who". 'You can ask me anything you want.' Any and its compounds can be used after if in a positive sentence. 'If anyone calls, tell them I'm not home.'
• No/not any can be used before plural countable nouns and uncountable nouns. 'There are no magazines on the table. There's no orange juice in the fridge.' No/not any and their compounds (no one/not anyone, nothing/not anything, etc) are used in negations. 'There's no one at the door. (=There isn't anyone at the door.)' Any and its compounds are used with negative words (hardly, never, without, seldom, rarely, etc.) 'He rarely goes anywhere. (not: He rarely goes nowhere.)'
• We use a singular verb with compounds of some, any and no. 'Someone is looking for you. There is no one in the room.'

O'NG USTUN:
Ko'k 'UNIT 13'. 'INFINITIVE - ING FORM': • We use to-infinitive after these verbs: decide, want, would like, would love, etc. 'I'd love to go out.' • We use -ing form after these verbs: love, like, hate, don't mind, etc. 'I love dancing.' • We use infinitive without to after modal verbs (might, can, etc) and the verbs let and make. 'He let me use his pen.'
To'q sariq 'UNIT 14'. 'DIRECT - REPORTED SPEECH': • Direct speech is exactly what someone says. '"I'll go to York," Jim said.' • Reported speech is the exact meaning of what someone said but not the exact words. 'Jim said (that) he would go to York.'
'SAY - TELL': • We use say with or without a personal pronoun. We use to after say when there is a personal pronoun. '"I can't help you," Tim said to me. He said that he would be on time.' • We use tell with a personal object pronoun. We never use to after tell. 'He told me that Sue had left. "Sue has left," he told me.'
'CHANGES IN REPORTED SPEECH': • When the reporting verb (say, tell etc) is in the present simple tense, the verb tenses do not change in reported speech. '"He is wrong," she says. (direct) She says he is wrong. (reported)' • When the reporting verb is in the past tense, the verb tenses change in reported speech. '"He is wrong," she said. (direct) She said he was wrong. (reported)'

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '126'.

exercises.instructionEn: Negative: no/not any - no one/not anyone/nobody/not anybody, nothing/not anything, nowhere/not anywhere. Rules for some, any, no and their compounds.
exercises.instructionUz: Inkor: no/not any - no one/not anyone/nobody/not anybody, nothing/not anything, nowhere/not anywhere. Some, any, no va ularning birikmalari qoidalari.
exercises.explanationUz:
SOME / ANY / NO - TO'LIQ QOIDA.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  INKOR BIRIKMALARI               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  no / not any
  no one = not anyone = nobody =
    not anybody (odam)
  nothing = not anything (narsa)
  nowhere = not anywhere (joy)

  ⚠ 'no one' bilan fe'l IJOBIY;
  'not anyone' bilan fe'l INKOR:
  "There's NO ONE at the door." =
  "There ISN'T ANYONE at the door."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SOME                            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar
  bilan: 'some oranges', 'some
  information'.
  Odatda IJOBIY gapda:
    "There's SOMEONE on the phone."
  SAVOLDA - taklif, iltimos, ijobiy
  javob kutilganda:
    'Would you like SOMETHING to
     drink?' (taklif)
    'Can I have SOMETHING to read?'
    (iltimos)
    'Is there SOMEONE in the living
     room?' (bor deb o'ylayman)
  LEKIN: 'Is there ANYONE in the
  living room?' (umuman so'rayapman)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ANY                             ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Odatda SAVOLDA:
    'Are there ANY apples?'
    'Is there ANYONE at home?'
  IJOBIY gapda = 'farqi yo'q, har
  qanday':
    'You can ask me ANYTHING you
     want.' (istalgan narsani)
  'IF' dan keyin ijobiy gapda:
    'If ANYONE calls, tell them I'm
     not home.'
  INKOR SO'ZLAR bilan (hardly,
  never, without, seldom, rarely):
    'He rarely goes ANYWHERE.'
    ('nowhere' EMAS - ikki inkor!)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  NO / NOT ANY                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'There are NO magazines on the
   table.'
  "There's NO orange juice."
  Birikmalari inkorda:
  "There's NO ONE at the door."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  FE'L - BIRLIK!                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'Someone IS looking for you.'
  'There IS no one in the room.'
  ⚠ 'Someone are' ✗.


⚠ 'TO EXPECT':

  = kutmoq.


⚠ 'IN GENERAL':

  = umuman.


⚠ 'IT DOESN'T MATTER':

  = farqi yo'q.


⚠ 'SELDOM':

  = kamdan-kam (= rarely).


⚠ 'HARDLY':

  = deyarli ... emas.

points.en: Negative: no/not any - no one/not anyone/nobody/not anybody (people), nothing/not anything (things), nowhere/not anywhere (places).
points.uz: Inkor: no/not any - no one/not anyone/nobody/not anybody (odamlar), nothing/not anything (narsalar), nowhere/not anywhere (joylar).

points.en: Some is used before plural nouns and countable/uncountable nouns. I need some oranges. She wanted some information. Some and its compounds are normally used in affirmative sentences. They can also be used in questions to make an offer, a request or when we expect a positive answer. Would you like something to drink? (offer) Can I have something to read? (request) Is there someone in the living room? (I expect there is.) but: Is there anyone in the living room? (I'm asking in general.)
points.uz: 'Some' ko'plik va sanaladigan/sanalmaydigan otlardan oldin ishlatiladi. Menga bir nechta apelsin kerak. U biroz ma'lumot xohladi. 'Some' va uning birikmalari odatda ijobiy gaplarda ishlatiladi. Ular savollarda ham taklif, iltimos yoki ijobiy javob kutganda ishlatilishi mumkin. Biror narsa ichasizmi? (taklif) O'qish uchun biror narsa olsam bo'ladimi? (iltimos) Mehmonxonada kimdir bormi? (bor deb o'ylayman) lekin: Mehmonxonada kimdir bormi? (umuman so'rayapman)
points.noteUz: ⚠ some - ijobiy, taklif, iltimos, kutilgan javob.

points.en: Any is used before plural countable nouns and uncountable nouns. Are there any apples in the fridge? Any and its compounds are normally used in questions. Is there anyone at home? They can also be used in positive sentences meaning "It doesn't matter how/what/when/where/which/who". You can ask me anything you want. Any and its compounds can be used after if in a positive sentence. If anyone calls, tell them I'm not home.
points.uz: 'Any' ko'plik sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlardan oldin ishlatiladi. Muzlatgichda olma bormi? 'Any' va uning birikmalari odatda savollarda ishlatiladi. Uyda kimdir bormi? Ular ijobiy gaplarda 'farqi yo'q' ma'nosida ham ishlatilishi mumkin. Mendan xohlagan narsangizni so'rashingiz mumkin. 'Any' va birikmalari ijobiy gapda 'if' dan keyin ishlatilishi mumkin. Agar kimdir qo'ng'iroq qilsa, uyda emasligimni ayt.

points.en: No/not any can be used before plural countable nouns and uncountable nouns. There are no magazines on the table. No/not any and their compounds are used in negations. There's no one at the door. (=There isn't anyone at the door.) Any and its compounds are used with negative words (hardly, never, without, seldom, rarely, etc.) He rarely goes anywhere. (not: He rarely goes nowhere.)
points.uz: 'No/not any' ko'plik sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlardan oldin ishlatilishi mumkin. Stolda jurnal yo'q. 'No/not any' va birikmalari inkorda ishlatiladi. Eshik oldida hech kim yo'q. 'Any' va birikmalari inkor so'zlar bilan ishlatiladi (hardly, never, without, seldom, rarely). U kamdan-kam biror joyga boradi. ('nowhere' EMAS.)

points.en: We use a singular verb with compounds of some, any and no. Someone is looking for you. There is no one in the room.
points.uz: Some, any va no birikmalari bilan birlik fe'l ishlatamiz. Kimdir sizni qidiryapti. Xonada hech kim yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: We use to-infinitive after these verbs: decide, want, would like, would love, etc. I'd love to go out. We use -ing form after these verbs: love, like, hate, don't mind, etc. I love dancing. We use infinitive without to after modal verbs (might, can, etc) and the verbs let and make. He let me use his pen.
exercises.instructionUz: To-infinitivni bu fe'llardan keyin ishlatamiz: decide, want, would like, would love va h.k. Tashqariga chiqishni juda xohlardim. -ing shaklini bu fe'llardan keyin ishlatamiz: love, like, hate, don't mind va h.k. Raqsga tushishni yaxshi ko'raman. 'To'siz infinitivni modal fe'llar (might, can va h.k.) hamda let va make fe'llaridan keyin ishlatamiz. U menga ruchkasini ishlatishga ruxsat berdi.
exercises.explanationUz:
INFINITIV yoki -ING? (13-unit)

  TO-INFINITIV:
    decide, want, would like, would
    love, refuse, agree, expect,
    begin, remember (unutmaslik),
    forget (qilishni unutmoq)
    "I'd love TO GO out."

  -ING ShAKLI:
    love, like, hate, don't mind,
    enjoy, can't stand, couldn't
    help, look forward to, stop
    (tashlamoq)
    'I love DANCING.'

  'TO'SIZ INFINITIV:
    modal fe'llar (might, can, must,
    will, would, could, may) va
    let, make
    'He LET me USE his pen.'
    'She MADE me LAUGH.'

  ⚠ To'liq jadval 96-betda.

points.en: We use to-infinitive after these verbs: decide, want, would like, would love, etc. I'd love to go out.
points.uz: To-infinitivni bu fe'llardan keyin ishlatamiz: decide, want, would like, would love va h.k. Tashqariga chiqishni juda xohlardim.

points.en: We use -ing form after these verbs: love, like, hate, don't mind, etc. I love dancing.
points.uz: -ing shaklini bu fe'llardan keyin ishlatamiz: love, like, hate, don't mind va h.k. Raqsga tushishni yaxshi ko'raman.

points.en: We use infinitive without to after modal verbs (might, can, etc) and the verbs let and make. He let me use his pen.
points.uz: 'To'siz infinitivni modal fe'llar (might, can va h.k.) hamda let va make fe'llaridan keyin ishlatamiz. U menga ruchkasini ishlatishga ruxsat berdi.

sections.title: Unit 14 - Direct / Reported Speech; Say - Tell; Changes
sections.titleUz: 14-unit - To'g'ridan-to'g'ri / ko'chirma gap; Say - Tell; O'zgarishlar

exercises.instructionEn: Direct speech is exactly what someone says. Reported speech is the exact meaning of what someone said but not the exact words. Say - Tell. Changes in reported speech.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap - kimdir aytgan aniq so'zlar. Ko'chirma gap - kimdir aytganining aniq ma'nosi, lekin aniq so'zlari emas. Say - Tell. Ko'chirma gapdagi o'zgarishlar.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP (14-unit).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI va KO'ChIRMA ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TO'G'RIDAN-TO'G'RI = aniq so'zlar
  (qo'shtirnoqda):
  "I'll go to York," Jim said.
  KO'ChIRMA = ma'nosi, so'zlar
  o'zgargan:
  Jim said (that) he WOULD go to
  York.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SAY yoki TELL                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SAY - olmoshsiz yoki 'TO' bilan:
    "I can't help you," Tim SAID TO
    ME.
    He SAID that he would be on
    time.
  TELL - har doim OLMOSh bilan,
  'to' YO'Q:
    He TOLD ME that Sue had left.
    "Sue has left," he TOLD ME.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ZAMON O'ZGARIShI                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Reporting verb HOZIRGI zamonda
  (says) → zamon O'ZGARMAYDI:
    "He is wrong," she SAYS. →
    She says he IS wrong.

  Reporting verb O'TGAN zamonda
  (said) → zamon O'ZGARADI:
    "He is wrong," she SAID. →
    She said he WAS wrong.

  ⚠ To'liq jadval 100-betda.


⚠ 'EXACTLY':

  = aynan.


⚠ 'ON TIME':

  = o'z vaqtida.

points.en: Direct speech is exactly what someone says. "I'll go to York," Jim said. Reported speech is the exact meaning of what someone said but not the exact words. Jim said (that) he would go to York.
points.uz: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap - kimdir aytgan aniq so'zlar. "Yorkka boraman", - dedi Jim. Ko'chirma gap - kimdir aytganining aniq ma'nosi, lekin aniq so'zlari emas. Jim Yorkka borishini aytdi.

points.en: We use say with or without a personal pronoun. We use to after say when there is a personal pronoun. "I can't help you," Tim said to me. He said that he would be on time.
points.uz: 'Say' ni olmosh bilan yoki olmoshsiz ishlatamiz. Olmosh bo'lsa 'say' dan keyin 'to' ishlatamiz. "Senga yordam bera olmayman", - dedi Tim menga. U o'z vaqtida bo'lishini aytdi.

points.en: We use tell with a personal object pronoun. We never use to after tell. He told me that Sue had left. "Sue has left," he told me.
points.uz: 'Tell' ni to'ldiruvchi olmosh bilan ishlatamiz. 'Tell' dan keyin hech qachon 'to' ishlatmaymiz. U menga Sue ketganini aytdi. "Sue ketdi", - dedi u menga.

points.en: When the reporting verb (say, tell etc) is in the present simple tense, the verb tenses do not change in reported speech. "He is wrong," she says. → She says he is wrong.
points.uz: Ko'chiruvchi fe'l (say, tell) hozirgi oddiy zamonda bo'lsa, ko'chirma gapda zamonlar o'zgarmaydi. "U noto'g'ri", - deydi u. → U uning noto'g'riligini aytadi.

points.en: When the reporting verb is in the past tense, the verb tenses change in reported speech. "He is wrong," she said. → She said he was wrong.
points.uz: Ko'chiruvchi fe'l o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa, ko'chirma gapda zamonlar o'zgaradi. "U noto'g'ri", - dedi u. → U uning noto'g'riligini aytdi.

patterns.exampleEn: If anyone calls, tell them I'm not home.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar kimdir qo'ng'iroq qilsa, uyda emasligimni ayt.

patterns.exampleEn: He let me use his pen.
patterns.exampleUz: U menga ruchkasini ishlatishga ruxsat berdi.

patterns.formula: X said to me / X told me (that) + GAP.
patterns.exampleEn: Tim said to me that he couldn't help. He told me that Sue had left.
patterns.exampleUz: Tim menga yordam bera olmasligini aytdi. U menga Sue ketganini aytdi.
